harvest.description: each alive fisher decides today's effort

propose.description: each alive fisher proposes a candidate community rule

critique.description: each proposal is refined through a bounded critique-and-revise dialogue before the vote

vote.description: each alive fisher votes on the refined proposals

lake_watcher.description: Manages Kai's role as lake-watcher, communal ledger with deposit tracking, and violation recording

catch_cap.description: Enforces 4kg per-trip catch limit; violations require surplus deposit to communal reserve

mandatory_reserve.description: Ensures each fisher maintains 1kg personal reserve for sustenance

communal_reserve.description: Manages communal reserve capped at 70kg; monitors lake mass and triggers automatic release to raise lake to 190kg when below 140kg
